root_cause.text: The `stream_encoder_create` function in AMD display resource files used an improper bounds check `eng_id <= ENGINE_ID_DIGF` (ENGINE_ID_DIGF = 5) which allowed `eng_id` values of 5 and negative values, causing out-of-bounds access when indexing the 5-element `stream_enc_regs[]` array (indices 0–4).
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states "eng_id can be negative and that stream_enc_regs[] can be indexed out of bounds. When eng_id is 5 (ENGINE_ID_DIGF) or negative, this can access memory past the end of the array." The patch replaces the flawed check with `if (eng_id < 0 || eng_id >= ARRAY_SIZE(stream_enc_regs))`, and the smatch error points to the line `&stream_enc_regs[eng_id]` being out of bounds.
